name: web-orlina-information-architecture-tree-with-red-silk
title: Orlina information architecture: red silk divider and a branching sitemap of pill nodes
whatItIs: A dark page with numbered goals (Easy Discovery, Visual Storytelling, Clear Navigation, Product Exploration), a red satin ribbon behind 'Information Architecture 03', and a sitemap drawn as thin diagonal lines branching from a bronze 'Home' pill to pills like New Arrivals, Men, Women, Kids and a checkout path.
whatItMeans: Clear yet stylish; a technical sitemap gets the same luxe treatment as the visuals.
techniques: Draw a sitemap with diagonal branches and pill nodes.
Highlight start and key nodes in the accent colour.

vocabulary.definition: How content and pages are organised.
A diagram of a site's pages and hierarchy.
